title: Customer Success Manager
description:
**About the Role**  
We're looking for a Customer Success Manager to own a dedicated book of client accounts from day one of the relationship onward — supporting presales conversations, driving smooth implementations, and becoming the trusted face of Provana for every client you manage. You'll be the person clients turn to for value realization and growth within their existing partnership with us.

**What You'll Do**

* Join Sales and Account Management calls to answer product questions and support the presales process
* Deliver standard client implementations on time, using our established playbooks
* Track product usage, run client check-ins, and lead regular business reviews
* Own renewal and retention for your book of accounts, using defined playbooks to manage risk and reduce churn
* Represent Provana credibly with client stakeholders — including senior decision-makers — on every account
* Build deep working knowledge of your clients' businesses, workflows, and regulatory environment
* Surface client feedback and product gaps directly to our Product team
* Identify and close upsell opportunities within your existing book, using current pricing and packaging

**What We're Looking For**

* 7+ years in a client-facing Customer Success, Account Management, or similar role — SaaS or a regulated/compliance-driven industry preferred
* A track record of managing renewals and hitting retention targets
* Comfort speaking to product capabilities with both technical and non-technical stakeholders
* Strong relationship-building skills and executive presence with senior client contacts
* Highly organized, playbook-driven approach to managing a multi-account book
* Familiarity with regulatory/compliance environments is a plus

Pay: ₹800,000.00 - ₹1,000,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Food provided
* Health insurance
* Leave encashment
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

title: Specialist, Customer Service
description:
Specialist, Customer Service (Team Lead, Program Coordinator )

At Pearson, our purpose is to help people realize the life they imagine through learning. We’re a place where talented people with different viewpoints can have their voices valued and heard and we’re intentionally building a culture of belonging designed to attract and promote innovative, and skilled people, where everyone has the opportunity to make progress in their careers

Under the direction of the Manager, the Team Lead, Program Coordinator is responsible for providing leadershipand support to the Program Coordinator team, as well as providing feedbackto employees performing the work to help ensure that customers receive great customer service. As a vital resource for both Program Coordinators and Clients, the Team Lead collaborates closely with the contact center and various other functional departments. The Program Coordinator Team Lead serves as the main operational contact for clients, acting as the knowledge expert for the contact center and providing information to other related functional areas.

Team support

* Assist with coordinating, documenting, and leading training of new team members
* Provide support and coaching on team and client inquiries
* Monitor PC team lead inbox and other team KPIs
* Research issues and complaints as well as assist with team metrics and reporting
* Monitor team absences and track attendance
* Lead, plan, and communicate effectively during various meetings as needed
* Serve as a backup for Program Coordinator and/or Supervisor tasks and projects. Act as an escalation point for resolving service-related problems, ensuring timely and effective resolutions
* Provide performance feedback (i.e. coaching) to team members via email and meetings
* Identify opportunities for continuous improvements on the Program Coordinator team to help support and encourage new and current team members.

Documentation and efficiency

* Help identify and implement process efficiencies.
* Work with Supervisor and Manager to ensure that team processes and policies are clearly defined and documented
* Maintain effective documentation for personal and team performance and team updates
* Plan, implement, and maintain new and existing client programs, ensuring client satisfaction and program success
* Execute and manage the data collection, distribution, and reporting of client programs with precision and timeliness

Other Task:

* Perform various other leadership duties as assigned, contributing to team success and cohesion

Education and Experience:

* Minimum High School Diploma or Equivalent
* Bachelor’s Degree preferred or equivalent work experience
* Experience training, teaching, or coaching
* 3+ years customer service experience preferred

Skills, Knowledge, and Abilities:

* Strong written and verbal communication skills
* Proven customer service and relationship‑management abilities
* Effective problem‑solving, judgment, and decision‑making skills
* Ability to manage conflict and handle escalations professionally
* Strong organizational, time‑management, and prioritization skills
* High attention to detail with the ability to set and meet goals
* Interpersonal skills with the ability to influence, coach, and collaborate
* Comfortable working in ambiguous situations and overcoming objections
* Adaptable and responsive in a fast‑paced, changing environment
* Patient, positive, and professional demeanor
* Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, Access, Outlook)
* Familiarity with training tools, learning styles, and coaching techniques
* Ability to identify, recommend, and implement efficiency improvements

Other (license/certification):

* Knowledge of Pearson VUE clients is preferred.
* Working knowledge of Registration Manager, VSS, and Service Direct.

**Who we are:**

At Pearson, our purpose is simple: to help people realize the life they imagine through learning. We believe that every learning opportunity is a chance for a personal breakthrough. We are the world's lifelong learning company. For us, learning isn't just what we do. It's who we are. To learn more: We are Pearson.

Pearson is an Equal Opportunity Employer and a member of E-Verify. Employment decisions are based on qualifications, merit and business need. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, national origin, protected veteran status, disability status or any other group protected by law. We actively seek qualified candidates who are protected veterans and individuals with disabilities as defined under VEVRAA and Section 503 of the Rehabilitation Act.

title: Senior Manager, Technical Product Management - Payment Domain
description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**

The Lead Technical Product Manager is responsible for guiding product strategy, leading technical execution, and developing a team of Technical Product Managers responsible for delivering AI-powered, consumer-facing healthcare experiences. This leader operates at the intersection of product management, technology, data, AI, and business strategy, owning outcomes from concept through adoption and business value realization.

This role partners across Product, Engineering, Architecture, AI Engineering, Design, Analytics, Operations, and Business stakeholders to build and scale digital experiences across web, mobile, and conversational channels. Areas of focus include Claims Assistant, Payment Experiences, intelligent document processing, reimbursement workflows, AI-powered self-service capabilities, and emerging member engagement experiences.

In addition to product ownership responsibilities, this role provides leadership, coaching, and development for Technical Product Managers, helping mature product management practices, technical capabilities, and AI-first ways of working across the organization.

**Primary Responsibilities:**

* Drive Product Strategy and Portfolio Direction
  + Partner with Product Directors, business leaders, and technology stakeholders to define strategy, investments, roadmaps, and priorities across Claims Assistant, Payments, and AI-powered member experiences. Identify opportunities to expand capabilities, improve member outcomes, and drive measurable business value.
* Scale Claims and Payment Experiences
  + Lead discovery, requirements, and execution efforts to expand Claims Assistant and payment capabilities into new member workflows, including claims submission, reimbursement experiences, digital payments, document intake, intelligent routing, and self-service experiences across web and mobile channels
* Lead Technical Product Delivery
  + Own product requirements, technical designs, API integrations, platform enhancements, AI capabilities, OCR workflows, and data dependencies required to deliver scalable and compliant consumer experiences. Translate business objectives into measurable technical outcomes and executable delivery plans
* Own Product Outcomes and Performance
  + Establish KPIs, success metrics, operational controls, and monitoring strategies to measure adoption, member satisfaction, completion rates, accuracy, automation effectiveness, payment success, and business impact. Drive continuous optimization based on product and operational performance
* Build and Develop TPM Talent
  + Lead, coach, and mentor Technical Product Managers responsible for product delivery across the portfolio. Establish performance expectations, develop technical product management capabilities, guide career growth, and help drive adoption of AI-enabled product management practices across the organization
* Comply with all applicable Company policies, procedures, and business directives, changes including those relating to work location, team assignments, work schedules, and flexible work arrangements

**Required Qualifications:**

* 7+ years of Product Management or Technical Product Management experience
* 3+ years leading enterprise-scale digital products serving external customers
* Experience owning product vision, strategy, roadmaps, objectives, KPIs, and business outcomes
* Experience delivering products in partnership with software engineering teams using Agile delivery models
* Experience leading large cross-functional initiatives involving multiple teams and stakeholders
* Experience working within highly regulated environments requiring security, compliance, and risk management considerations
* Demonstrated solid ability to translate business needs into detailed product requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and delivery plans

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Product & Technical Leadership
  + 5+ years working closely with software engineering teams in Agile environments
  + Experience working with cloud-native applications and modern digital platforms
  + Experience supporting complex web, mobile, and omnichannel product ecosystems
  + Experience influencing technical strategy across multiple product teams
  + Solid understanding of APIs, microservices, distributed systems, event-driven architectures, and integration patterns
  + Demonstrated ability to read architecture diagrams, sequence diagrams, technical designs, system flows, and integration documentation
* AI & Intelligent Automation
  + 3+ years delivering AI, ML, OCR, GenAI, intelligent document processing, or automation solutions
  + Experience defining AI product requirements, evaluation criteria, guardrails, success metrics, and operational controls
  + Understanding of LLMs, prompt engineering, model evaluation methodologies, AI governance, and operational monitoring
  + Understanding of responsible AI, compliance, privacy, and risk considerations for customer-facing AI experiences
  + Familiarity with AI performance metrics including accuracy, precision, latency, confidence scoring, hallucination rates, and drift detection
* Claims & Payments
  + Experience with healthcare claims, reimbursement, payment operations, payment platforms, or financial transaction processing
  + Experience building digital self-service experiences for consumers or members
  + Experience identifying and scaling platform capabilities across multiple business use cases
  + Knowledge of payment workflows, digital reimbursement models, payment flexibility solutions, funds disbursement, and transaction lifecycle management
* People Leadership
  + Experience leading, coaching, or developing Product Managers or Technical Product Managers
  + Experience establishing operating models, product management best practices, and delivery frameworks
  + Demonstrated ability to build high-performing product teams
  + Demonstrated solid ability to influence senior leadership and align diverse stakeholder groups around shared outcomes

*At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone-of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location and income-deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes - an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.*

title: Technical Customer Solutions Manager, India CSM Team
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Sales, Marketing and Global Services (SMGS)  
AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small- and mid-market accounts to enterprise-level customers including public sector.
  
  
As a Customer Solution Manager you will work with the largest and most complex enterprises in the world, to enable their multi-year journey to the cloud. In this new, highly visible, role you will ensure that all AWS teams work together effectively and efficiently to deliver migration, modernization and GenAI outcomes for the customer in relation to Amazon Web Services (AWS) Cloud.
  
  
Key job responsibilities  
You will be a trusted advisor to the customer. You will leverage your complex program management, technical, organizational, and transformation expertise to understand customer's business and strategic goals, translate them into an executable plan, and drive the implementation to success by working with the customer, AWS, and our partners. You will understand your customers' biggest IT challenges and provide prescriptive guidance, based on AWS best practices, to guide them through their migration and modernization journey to AWS at scale.  
  
You will take end-to-end ownership of multiple migration, modernization and GenAI projects within a single enterprise or across several enterprises, utilizing your communication skills to interface with and influence a broad range of multi-disciplinary teams (Business development, solutions architecture, support, product, professional services, and partners). The Customer Solution Manager role is responsible for cloud migration and modernization programs (incl. technical, operational, organizational, and education) that span across traditional IT teams and business units.  
  
Engaging from the inception stage onwards, you will have a deep understanding of your customer's business vision, culture, and processes, you will be your customer's voice within AWS, ensuring that their needs are accurately communicated to AWS leadership, product, and engineering teams. Engaging during the latter stages of the business cycle you will be responsible for ensuring consistent best-practices are applied, including: (1) ensuring Migration Readiness Assessment (MRA) is conducted and bringing in SMEs to deliver the migration foundations (e.g. landing zone build, security controls, operating model, training etc.), (2) Migration kick off workshops are conducted (including stakeholder alignment), and (3) Executive Steering Committees and reporting are established, including customer, partner, and AWS Cloud exec sponsors and ensure mechanisms are in place to identify and mitigate any identified risks. You should be passionate about delivering a great customer experience by delivering successful IT transformation programs. You will ensure that the customer IT and business stakeholders are aligned, to ensure broad adoption of the migration and modernization across the customer organization. You will use AWS mechanisms to inform the customer migration journey. Where required, you will lead the interaction with specialist teams, ProServ and Partners for handoffs, especially with respect to migreation, modernization and GenAI implementation.  
  
In addition to your customer facing responsibilities, you will help shape the rapidly growing Customer Solution Management function, where your passion to define and implement standard processes, methodologies, and tools will be highly valued. Passionate about customer value creation, you will be adept at measuring and quantifying customer value realization and ensuring it stays on path. Successful candidates will have a technical program management background, technology foundation and consultative mindset, be detail driven, and have experience in managing teams to deliver complex programs. You will be a passionate and proven leader with the ability to gain stakeholder buy-in, communicate confidently at both the executive and project team level, and collaborate with a wide range of technical and non-technical teams, regardless of geographical or organizational boundaries to ensure compliance with AWS Standards, policies and best practices. You will be comfortable in working with diverse teams to ensure appropriate partners are on-boarded and involved in the migration as required. Be an active participant of steering committees and governance structures regardless of who is leading the migration and modernization and act as the point of contact for escalations if the migration and modernization hits barriers. You will be proactive in assessing Migration and modernization progress and design and implement plans to mitigate any risks or delays. Along with project management cadence, you will support the people and process pillars of migration including CCOE design and be the overall owner of reporting and system updates related to the health of migration. You will be a natural problem solver with a cool head that can deal with ambiguity, work autonomously to drive the deliver results for your customer, build IP, and share best practice across geographies.

title: Sr Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
At Adobe, you will be immersed in an exceptional work environment that is recognized around the world. Adobe is listed as Fortune’s “100 Best Companies to Work For” for 20 consecutive years. You will also be surrounded by colleagues who are committed to helping each other grow. If you’re looking to make an impact, Adobe's the place for you. Discover what our employees are saying about their career experiences on the Adobe Life blog and explore the meaningful benefits we offer.
  
  
Changing the world through digital experiences is what Adobe’s all about. We give global brands everything they need to design and deliver exceptional digital experiences. We’re passionate about transforming how companies interact with customers across every screen.
  
The Opportunity
  
Adobe Experience Platform and Apps powers real-time customer experiences for the world’s largest enterprises — unifying data, resolving identity at scale, orchestrating journeys, and activating audiences across channels.
  
  
The Forward Deployed Engineer sits at the intersection of solution architecture, technical consulting, and hands-on engineering. You’ll work directly with Adobe’s strategic customers to solve complex platform challenges, design scalable architectures, and build solutions that accelerate adoption.
  
You’ll operate in a multi-functional Customer Pod with end-to-end ownership, partnering with customers, product teams, and engineers to turn complex problems into working solutions.
  
What You’ll Do
  
Partner with strategic customers to understand their architecture, workflows, security requirements, and business objectives.
  
Translate complex customer problems into scalable solution designs, reference architectures, and working prototypes.
  
Investigate and resolve production-level platform issues across data ingestion, identity resolution, journey orchestration, and audience activation.
  
Design and validate enterprise solutions spanning AEP, AJO, Marketo, and adjacent Adobe systems.
  
Lead architecture workshops, health checks, and technical deep-dives that build customer trust.
  
Prototype, experiment, and iterate rapidly, using AI-assisted tools as part of your everyday workflow.
  
Connect customer needs with product and engineering teams, bringing field insights back into the product roadmap.
  
Own the technical relationship with assigned accounts from discovery through implementation, launch, and expansion.
  
What Success Looks Like
  
We hire for demonstrated impact and experience. You’ll bring a combination of technical depth, customer empathy, and collaborative problem solving.
  
**Hands-on engineering:** You write code, build prototypes, and ship working software. Your architecture decisions are grounded in implementation experience.
  
**Customer empathy:** You understand customers’ goals, constraints, and definitions of success and build trusted relationships through empathy and technical expertise.
  
**Collaboration and communication:** You work effectively with engineers, architects, product managers, and leaders and communicate complex concepts clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
  
**Enterprise architecture:** You design end-to-end solutions across products and systems, considering integration, scale, security, and production requirements.
  
**Data expertise:** You understand how data is structured, modeled, and moved and can evaluate trade-offs in schema design, identity resolution, and data pipelines.
  
**AI fluency and continuous learning:** You embrace AI-assisted development tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or equivalent to design, prototype, and deliver solutions.
  
**Proactive problem solving:** You identify emerging challenges and take initiative to move them toward resolution.
  
What You Need to Succeed

title: R&D Engineering, Sr Engineer
description:
### **We Are**
Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI\-powered products. We deliver industry\-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R\&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.

### **You Are**


You are someone who looks at a test failure and does not just log it, you dig until you understand why it happened and what it means for the next release. Scripting is not a chore for you, it is how you make repetitive work disappear so you can focus on the problems that actually need a human brain. You have spent enough time in labs or codebases to know that quality is not something you test in at the end, it is something you build into the process from the start.


Data tells you stories. When you see a trend in regression results, you do not wait for someone else to notice, you pull the thread, ask the right questions, and surface what matters. You are comfortable working across teams, translating between what verification found, what design needs to know, and what a release checklist actually requires.


You do not need years of experience to have a point of view. You know when a process is not working and you are not afraid to suggest a better way. At Synopsys, you will work on Embedded Memory IP that powers the devices people use every day, and the rigor you bring to testing and automation will directly affect whether those products ship on time and work as promised.

### **What You'll Be Doing**

* Run kickoff and release meetings across design, verification, and release teams, making sure compliance checkpoints are hit and nothing falls through the cracks
* Execute regression testing on Embedded Memory IP, catch issues before they reach customers, and track results across release cycles
* Analyze test data to spot trends, recurring failures, and process gaps that affect product quality or schedule
* Write and maintain Python and Tcl automation scripts that eliminate manual testing steps and speed up validation workflows
* Coordinate with cross\-functional teams to align on quality gates, release criteria, and issue resolution timelines
* Document test results, failure analysis, and process improvements in a way that helps the next engineer understand what happened and why

### **The Impact You Will Have**

* Ensure Embedded Memory IP on advanced process nodes ships with zero critical defects, directly affecting customer success and market readiness
* Reduce validation cycle time by automating repetitive test and data collection tasks, freeing engineers to focus on complex debug work
* Surface quality and process issues early in the development cycle, preventing costly delays and rework downstream
* Improve the reliability of regression infrastructure so teams can trust test results and make faster release decisions
* Strengthen compliance and traceability across the release process, reducing risk and audit friction
* Enable smarter decision\-making by turning raw test data into actionable insights for design and verification teams

### **What You'll Need**

* Bachelor's degree in Electronics and Communication Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field
* 2 years of experience in validation, testing, quality assurance, or a related engineering role
* Working knowledge of Python or Tcl for scripting and automation
* Ability to analyze data, identify patterns, and communicate findings clearly to technical and non\-technical audiences
* Familiarity with regression testing, release processes, or quality management systems is a plus
* Strong problem\-solving instincts and the ability to work across teams without losing track of details

### **Who You Are**

* You can look at a spreadsheet of test results and spot the one anomaly that matters, not just the loudest failure
* You write scripts that other people can actually read and modify six months later
* You are comfortable running a meeting with senior engineers and keeping it focused without being intimidated
* When a process does not make sense, you ask why before you follow it blindly
* You can explain a technical issue to a release manager in two sentences without losing the nuance
* You stay organized when managing multiple release tracks, test cycles, and compliance checkpoints at once

### **The Team You'll Be Part Of**


Your recruiter will share more about the team structure and mission during the interview process.

### **Rewards and Benefits**


We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non\-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

title: Senior Computer Scientist - C++
description:
The Opportunity
  
Adobe builds products that power millions of customer experiences worldwide. Behind these products are sophisticated software systems operating at scale, where performance, reliability, security, and engineering excellence are fundamental requirements.
  
We are looking for a Senior Computer Scientist with deep C\+\+ expertise who enjoys solving complex technical problems and taking ownership of significant areas of the product. You will shape architecture, build high\-performance software, make critical technical decisions, and influence solutions that span components and teams.
  
We value engineers who are self\-driven, proactive, and outcome\-oriented — engineers who challenge assumptions, solve problems at their root, make pragmatic tradeoffs, and take responsibility for making the systems they own better, more reliable, and easier to evolve.
  
  

What You'll Do
  
Own and evolve significant technical areas end\-to\-end — from understanding ambiguous problems and defining the right solution through architecture, implementation, production validation, and long\-term evolution.
  
Design and build high\-performance C\+\+ systems , making thoughtful decisions around architecture, concurrency, memory management, resource utilization, and scalability.
  
Drive technical direction for complex problems — evaluate alternatives, make pragmatic tradeoffs, and influence architecture decisions across components and teams.
  
Solve problems at the root — identify systemic causes rather than treating symptoms, and drive durable solutions that reduce recurring issues and technical debt.
  
Own outcomes, not just tasks — proactively identify gaps, risks, and opportunities and drive them to closure with minimal direction.
  
Solve complex problems across boundaries , collaborating with engineers, architects, product managers, and other teams to deliver cohesive solutions.
  
Raise the engineering bar through architecture and code reviews, performance optimization, testing, and engineering best practices.
  
Build for operational excellence with strong focus on performance, reliability, security, observability, maintainability, and efficient resource utilization.
  
Be a force multiplier — mentor engineers, share technical expertise, and establish patterns and practices that improve the broader engineering organization.
  
Leverage AI\-assisted engineering to accelerate development and problem solving, improve engineering workflows, and increase team productivity.

B.Tech/M.Tech in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  
10\+ years of hands\-on software engineering experience , with a strong track record of owning and delivering complex technical solutions.
  
Deep expertise in C\+\+ , including modern C\+\+, memory management, concurrency, multithreading, STL, and performance optimization.
  
Strong foundation in data structures, algorithms, object\-oriented design, operating systems, and computer science fundamentals .
  
Strong understanding of systems design, distributed systems, concurrency, scalability, and performance engineering .

Experience with cloud platforms, distributed infrastructure, and modern software development practices.
  
Strong proficiency in AI\-assisted engineering , leveraging tools such as Claude, Codex, or Copilot to accelerate development, improve problem solving, and enhance engineering productivity.
  
Strong technical judgment and problem\-solving ability , with the ability to navigate ambiguity and influence technical decisions across teams.
  
  

What Success Looks Like
  
Success in this role is not measured only by the features you deliver. You will be successful when you:
  
Own and evolve significant technical areas with minimal direction and strong technical judgment.
  
Turn ambiguous, complex problems into clear technical direction and executable solutions .
  
Make architecture decisions that balance performance, scalability, reliability, maintainability, and long\-term evolution .
  
Solve systemic problems at their root and eliminate recurring sources of complexity, performance issues, and operational risk.

title: Executive Assistant to CEO
description:
### **Executive Assistant to CEO**

  

Reporting directly to the CEO, the Executive Assistant provides executive support in a one\-on\-one working relationship. The Executive Assistant serves as the primary point of contact for internal and external constituencies on all matters involving the CEO. The Executive Assistant also serves as a liaison to the Core Committee and senior management teams; organizes and coordinates executive outreach and external relations efforts; and oversees special projects. The ideal individual will have the ability to exercise good judgment in a variety of situations, with strong written and verbal communication, administrative, and organizational skills, and the ability to maintain a realistic balance among multiple priorities. The Executive Assistant will have the ability to work independently on projects, from conception to completion, and must be able to work under pressure and travel at times to handle a wide variety of activities and confidential matters with discretion.

 **Specific responsibilities:**

  

* Completes a broad variety of administrative tasks for the CEO, including managing an extremely active calendar of appointments; completing expense reports; composing and preparing correspondence that is sometimes confidential; arranging complex and detailed travel plans, itineraries, and agendas; and compiling documents for travel\-related meetings. Plans, coordinates, and ensures the CEO's schedule is followed and respected. Provides "gatekeeper" and "gateway" roles, creating win\-win situations for direct access to the CEO's time and office

  

* Communicates directly, on behalf of the CEO, with the Core Committee, Administration, HR, Operations, Branches, Zonal managers, Processing, Accounts, legal, etc.

  

* Research prioritizes, and follows up on incoming issues and concerns addressed to the CEO, including those of a sensitive or confidential nature. Determines the appropriate course of action, referral, or response.

  

* Provides a bridge for smooth communication between the CEO and internal departments; demonstrating leadership to maintain credibility, trust, \& support with senior management staff.

  

* Works closely and effectively with the CEO to keep him well informed of upcoming commitments and responsibilities, following up appropriately. Acts as a "barometer," having a sense of the issues taking place in the environment and keeping the CEO updated.

  

* Provides leadership to build relationships crucial to the success of the organization, and manages a variety of projects for the CEO, some of which may have organizational impact.

  

* Completes critical aspects of deliverables with a hands\-on approach, including drafting acknowledgement letters, personal correspondence, and other tasks that facilitate the CEO's ability to effectively lead the company.

  

* Prioritizes conflicting needs; handles matters expeditiously, and proactively, and follows through on projects to successful completion, often with deadline pressures.

 **NB:** The principal responsibilities listed above are an illustrative list and not an exhaustive list. Additional responsibilities will be added from time to time, depending on organizational requirements.

 **KEY SELECTION CRITERIA**

**Qualification**

  

* Any UG degree with relevant experience
* MBA Corporate Governance / Secretarial Course preferred

**Experience**


Minimum of 3 to 5 years’ experience in administration.

**Age**


25–30 years

**Sex**


Female/Male (Preference for Female candidates)

**Computer skills**

* Excellent MS Office, internet and emails

**Language skills**

* Good written and oral communication skills in English.
* Good email\-drafting skills in English
* **Functional skills**
* Good verbal and written communication \& presentation skills with strong business\-related knowledge
* Strong organizational skills that reflect the ability to perform and prioritize multiple tasks seamlessly with excellent attention to detail
* Very strong interpersonal skills and the ability to build relationships with stakeholders, including staff, Core committee, and external partners § Expert level written and verbal communication skills
* Demonstrated proactive approaches to problem\-solving with strong decision\-making capability
* Emotional maturity
* Proven ability to handle confidential information with discretion, be adaptable to various competing demands, and demonstrate the highest level of customer/client service and response
* Demonstrated ability to achieve high\-performance goals and meet deadlines in a fast\-paced environment
* Forward\-looking thinker, who actively seeks opportunities and proposes solutions

**Pay Scale**


Rs 3\.6 lakh to 5\.4 lakh per annum

 **Probation**


3 months

1 week (paid training)

Yearly increment \| Performance Bonus \| Paid Leaves \| Company Laptop and Mobile phone with SIM card

No Work\-from\-Home benefit
